_comment: P1-01 404-page redirect registry. Populate the empty 'redirects' array from the GSC export: Search Console > Indexing > Pages > 'Not found (404)'. Each entry: {"source": "/old-url", "destination": "/new-url", "permanent": true, "reason": "..."}. Then run: node scripts/populate-redirects.mjs (writes vercel.json redirects + nginx-redirects.conf).
